content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains frequent explicit sexual content and is intended for adults only.

The protagonist is the same succubus heroine featured in previous Steam titles Doki Doki Tri-Line Quest and Succubus Roulette. In this game, she experiences game-over scenes involving possession by a seductive ghost that leads to highly sexual situations. These scenes include supernatural domination and trance-like states, where she vocally resists the possession of her body — creating moments that may be perceived as non-consensual or coercive.

However, in the lore of the series, the protagonist is a half-succubus who actively seeks new sexual experiences, and derives energy through intimacy. As established in prior games, she ultimately enjoys these encounters — even when initially surprised or resistant — due to her nature and curiosity. The tone of the scenes is erotic, not violent.

The sexual content includes:

Full-frontal nudity

Female masturbation with visible squirting

Vaginal intercourse (woman on top)

Oral sex and facial ejaculation

Mild bondage and domination themes

Possession and mind control as supernatural sexual fantasy elements

Sensitive topics present:

The game includes fantasy depictions of non-consensual sexual activity (possession and mind control).

There are no depictions of suicide, self-harm, or drug/alcohol abuse.

This game is intended strictly for mature audiences. Player discretion is strongly advised.
